symptom: ako/mxcli#1743 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1662): a text box's Studio Pro Events -> 'On enter key press' had no MDL property. `OnEnterKeyPress:`, `OnEnterKeyPressAction:` and `OnEnterKey:` were each reported as "not a property mxcli writes on a textbox (Forms$TextBox), so it would be dropped" (MDL-V1-WIDGETPROP; MDL-WIDGET07 at v0.28.0), exec dropped it, describe printed nothing and mx check passed; `OnChange:` on the same widget was written. Describe -> exec of a page holding one replaced it with nothing (measured 11.13.0: 3 stored actions -> 0, 'Replaced page', mx check 0 errors)
cause: No reader anywhere: the builder never read a key for it, describe never read Forms$TextBox.OnEnterKeyPressAction, and the TextBox case of widgetToGen hard-coded g.SetOnEnterKeyPressAction(noActionGen()). carryNoActionExecution does not help: it carries only DisabledDuringExecution between two NoActions, never a stored action
file: mdl/executor/input_event_actions.go (inputEventActions table, buildInputEventAction, inputEventHint); mdl/executor/widget_native_props.go (textbox reads); mdl/executor/validate_widget_action_slot.go (validateInputEventActions); mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (TextBox case); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go, cmd_pages_describe_output.go
fix: `OnEnterKeyPress:` (the stored name `OnEnterKeyPressAction:` accepted; both at once refused, MDL-WIDGET18) read through the generic `key: action` grammar branch, converted by actionFromFlowDataSource when a flow call without `call` parses as a data source, built by buildClientActionV3, written into OnEnterKeyPressAction, described back as `OnEnterKeyPress:`; a value that is not an action is MDL-WIDGET28. On every other widget the per-kind check refuses it with the reason. describe -> exec of the fixed page: 'Unchanged page'; mx check 0 errors
insight: Two greps settle this class faster than reasoning. (1) grep the writer for `(noActionGen())` handed to a named slot setter: each one is an event slot that can never be filled — the 'hardcoded literal in a *ToGen helper' tell — and also a round-trip loss for Studio Pro pages, not only a missing feature (OnEnterAction/OnLeaveAction on the input widgets were in the same state). (2) Check a reporter's 'widget X has the same property' against gen, not against Studio Pro's UI: `grep SetOnEnterKeyPressAction modelsdk/gen/pages/types.go` names TextBox alone, so on a text area the right fix is a refusal with the reason, not a write. No grammar keyword was needed: the generic `(IDENTIFIER|keyword) COLON actionExprV3` branch already parses the value; the only extra shape is the data-source parse of `microflow M.F` / `nanoflow M.F` / `$x` (namedActionSlotValue's case). Keep the reader out of cmd_pages_builder*.go and emit via actionProp, so the cross-widget union (staticWidgetKnownProps) does not learn a textbox-only key while the per-kind source scan still sees both. ALTER `set (OnChange: ...) on <textbox>` is refused today (SetWidgetNamedAction: not a pluggable widget), so the new key is equally refused there — parity, not a regression
